phase_name: Rebase both Neovim agents in nvim/index-entries.json

objectives.description: Extract real @-reference sets for both Neovim agents
objectives.note: neovim-research-agent: 5 refs (2 core-owned: return-metadata-file.md, report-format.md; 3 nvm-owned: README.md, neovim-api.md, plugin-ecosystem.md). neovim-implementation-agent: 8 refs, exactly matching the plan's explicit list (5 core-owned core bundle + 3 nvm-owned: lua-style-guide.md, plugin-spec.md, keymap-patterns.md).

objectives.description: neovim-research-agent: keep unconditional refs, move conditional/unreferenced to task_types-only
objectives.note: Dropped 13 of 14 hooked nvm-owned entries (all already carried task_types:[neovim], so no on_demand needed), keeping only project/neovim/domain/neovim-api.md. Per the plan/report's Finding 4 explicit floor computation (~7,360), README.md and plugin-ecosystem.md were deliberately dropped despite being genuinely @-referenced -- the same 'referenced but rare/conditional -> drop' treatment applied to general-research-agent's checkpoint-before-overflow.md in Phase 3. Added neovim-research-agent to the two core-owned entries (formats/return-metadata-file.md, formats/report-format.md), coordinating the core-file addition directly since this session executes all phases sequentially rather than via separate file-scoped agents.

objectives.description: neovim-implementation-agent: hook its 8 genuine unconditional references, drop the rest
objectives.note: Dropped 19 of 22 hooked nvm-owned entries (all retained task_types:[neovim], no on_demand needed), keeping lua-style-guide.md+plugin-spec.md+keymap-patterns.md (6,088 tok). Added neovim-implementation-agent to the 5 core-owned core-bundle entries (return-metadata-file.md, progress-file.md, summary-format.md, phase-closure.md, pre-edit-gate.md -- previously not hooked to this agent at all, confirming the plan's under-inclusion finding).

objectives.description: Drop the meta-builder-agent hook on project/neovim/domain/extension-deploy-modes.md (Phase 2 deferred item)
objectives.note: Confirmed unreferenced by meta-builder-agent.md (zero grep matches for 'extension-deploy-modes'). Dropped; all hooks (agents/task_types, no commands key) became empty, so on_demand:true was set (this is the single Dead-Entry-Check-relevant on_demand marker from this phase).

objectives.description: Drop standards/git-staging-scope.md's neovim-implementation-agent hook (Phase 4's own note, core file)
objectives.note: Confirmed not @-referenced by neovim-implementation-agent.md. Dropped; commands[] hook (5 commands) kept the entry non-empty, no on_demand needed.
